title: Cymba solid marble mannequin with violet surface fibres — reference v6
direction: Solid opaque softly honed ivory marble head; no cutaway or internal anatomy; detailed organic surface-only nerve fibres dominated by violet, amethyst and lilac; open blank sculpted eyes.
notes: These are artistic nerve-fibre stimulation overlays, not validated maps of anatomical surface nerves.
Generated views share a design direction but may differ slightly in geometry and fibre placement; reconcile during 3D modelling.
No live-site code or 3D model was changed.

prompts.stage: solid head and violet surface fibres
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: supplied three-quarter ivory marble mannequin.
Preserve the same face, blank open stone eyes, pleasant neutral expression, realistic unobstructed ears, head-and-neck proportions, softly honed creamy marble with faint mineral veins, camera angle, framing, pale grey background and soft studio light.

RESTORE A SOLID HEAD:
Completely remove the cranial opening, exposed brain, internal brainstem, cavity, stone rim and every inside-the-head effect. Rebuild a normal smooth rounded scalp in the SAME opaque ivory stone as the face. The finished head must be a continuous closed solid sculpture. No cutaway, lid, seams, brain-shaped surface lumps, visible interior, glass, translucency or x-ray effect.

SURFACE NERVE FIBRES:
Show the neural stimulation exclusively as delicate luminous fibres lying flush ON THE OUTER SURFACE of the stone, following the curved scalp, behind-ear region and lateral neck. Replace the simple thick glowing tree lines with a more biologically inspired branching fibre structure: small bundles of several slender slightly undulating parallel strands, naturally tapering branches, irregular organic bifurcations and fine terminal filaments. Moderate intricate detail concentrated across the sides, upper back and crown of the head, with generous clear stone between bundles. Never a dense full-head web. Main routes should be recognizable while finer fibres are visible close up. Keep eyes, brows, nose, lips and most of the forehead and cheek completely clear.
At the concha show a small delicate fibre cluster, connecting around behind the ear toward the skull-base/upper-nape region. Continue two distinct main vagal fibre bundles down the left and right lateral neck to its cut base. The near-side bundle should be clearly visible. Show the occipital/brainstem-region connection ONLY as an external surface illustration, not an exposed anatomical part or a central line down the spine.

COLOR AND STIMULATION:
Strongly favor PURPLE over pink: amethyst, violet and lilac with tiny cool lavender-white bright segments suggesting pulses moving through individual fibres. Roughly 90 percent violet/purple, only the faintest occasional mauve undertone. No hot pink, salmon, magenta-dominant lighting, gold or amber. Fine luminous cores with restrained soft bloom, a few short slightly brighter active segments, no giant glowing nodes, no lightning bolts, no electrical sparks, no circuitry, no metallic cables or thick neon tubes.

Result: refined premium stone sculpture, solid and opaque, with realistic-looking organic violet nerve-fibre stimulation drawn ON its surface as an artistic visualization. No additional objects, labels, text, logo, earbuds or wires.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: matching four-angle 3D modelling reference sheet.
Input image: exact finished sculpture reference. Preserve its face, blank eyes, creamy fine-veined honed stone material, solid closed head, and violet surface nerve fibres.

Create a square 2x2 sheet of this SAME sculpture from four orthographic eye-level camera directions. Top left FRONT; top right LEFT PROFILE, nose pointing right; bottom left RIGHT PROFILE, nose pointing left; bottom right REAR. Equal scale, neutral upright head relative to neck, full crown and neck base in each cell, aligned bases and comfortable spacing. No labels or dividers.
The head must remain fully SOLID OPAQUE stone, normal smooth rounded scalp, same forehead and skull shape. No opening, cutaway, visible brain, brainstem organ, inner anatomy, glass dome, translucent material, removable lid, seam or reflective helmet in any view.

Keep the exact softened adult facial proportions, pleasant neutral mouth and open blank stone eyes: no irises, pupils, eye rings, glints or eyeball color. Realistic full unobstructed ears, no hair or beard. Soft creamy ivory marble with faint subtle mineral veining, restrained fine grain and satin-matte stone finish, not coarse rough limestone. Head-and-neck sculpture only, no shoulder/chest extension or separate pedestal.

Replicate the surface-only organic nerve fibres from the reference in the same consistent locations as the camera rotates: fine bundles of slightly wavy parallel strands, tapering organic branches and small terminal filaments spread over the sides, upper rear and crown. Preserve large areas of clear stone; no dense web across the face. Thin clustered fibres within each concha and behind each ear connect toward the skull-base/upper-nape region, with distinct left and right lateral nerve bundles descending to the neck cut. Front shows both lateral bundles and near-temple branches. Side profiles show detailed ear, scalp and lateral-neck fibres. Rear clearly shows the continuation of the crown/occipital fibre network and both lateral descending neck bundles, with a quiet clear center of the nape. No giant central cable down the back, no spinal cord or vertebrae.
All fibres sit flush on the OUTSIDE of the sculpture. Never appear inside it.
Color is overwhelmingly violet, amethyst and lilac, with fine lavender-white active segments. More purple than pink, no hot pink dominance, no orange, no giant bright nodes or thick neon tubes. Match the source's brightness and elegant realistic nerve-fibre texture, subtly lit with restrained bloom.

Uniform cool pale grey studio background, soft key and fill with gentle contact shadows, every view sharp and complete. No text, logos, watermark, jewelry, clothing, earbuds, cables or props.
